import json,glob,collections
types=collections.Counter(); cls=collections.Counter(); eff=collections.Counter(); replies=0; sess=collections.Counter()
for f in glob.glob('control-plane/decision-queue/cards/*.json'):
    try: d=json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8'))
    except Exception: continue
    types[d.get('type')]+=1
    cls[(d.get('recommendation') or {}).get('class')]+=1
    eff[d.get('effect')]+=1
    sess[d.get('sessionID')]+=1
    if 'replied' in d or d.get('status')!='pending': replies+=1
print('всего карточек:',sum(types.values()))

print('не-pending (replied-контур):',replies)
